topic: Fixing Average Number of Screen Seen data
summary_markdown: The conversation focused on debugging and resolving discrepancies in the 'Average Number of Screen Seen (Cluster)' metric. Initially, a data issue was observed where cluster metrics varied significantly across different sensor counts (e.g., 7.5 vs 8.2 vs 1.4). [me] confirmed that a previous fix related to `dwell-time` had been implemented. Subsequently, [me] provided specific instructions regarding the 'Average Number of Screen Seen (Cluster)' metric, and later confirmed that the necessary fix was applied within the STAGE dataset.
decisions: The data issue for Average Number of Screen Seen (Cluster) was resolved.
